Check for Free Appointments and Send a Pushover Notification

Source: R/check_appointments.R
check_appointments.Rd

Checks the booking calendar of the API Potsdam for free appointments (see get_free_appointments()) and sends a notification with the Pushover app if there are any.

Usage

check_appointments(
  event_type = "D",
  insurance = "gesetzlich",
  send_pushover_notification = FALSE,
  state_file = NULL,
  priority = 1L,
  from = today_berlin(),
  to = as.Date(from) + 365,
  config = api_potsdam_config(),
  dbg = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

event_type

appointment type(s) ("Terminart") to check. Either the letter shown on the booking page (e.g. "D" for "D. Saeuglings- u. Kleinkindsprechstunde"), the samedi id, the slug or a (unique) part of the name, see get_event_types(). Several appointment types can be given as a vector. Default: "D"

insurance

health insurance ("Krankenversicherung"), see insurances(). Default: "gesetzlich"

send_pushover_notification

should a Pushover notification be sent if there are (new) free appointments? Default: FALSE

state_file

optional path to a text file in which the appointments that a notification was already sent for are stored. If given, a notification is only sent for appointments that are not yet contained in the file, i.e. you are not notified again and again about the same appointments. If send_pushover_notification is TRUE, the file is overwritten with the currently free appointments after the notification was sent (or if there was nothing new to send). An appointment that disappears and becomes free again is therefore reported again. Default: NULL (notify about all free appointments on each call)

priority

Pushover message priority from -2 (lowest) to 2. Default: 1 (high priority, bypasses the quiet hours of the Pushover app). With 2 (emergency) the notification is repeated every retry seconds (default: 60) until it is acknowledged in the Pushover app, for at most expire seconds (default: 3600); retry and expire can be passed via ....

from

first day to look for free appointments (default: today in Potsdam, i.e. time zone "Europe/Berlin")

to

last day to look for free appointments (default: one year after from)

config

settings as returned by api_potsdam_config()

dbg

print debug messages? Default: TRUE

...

further arguments passed to pushoverr::pushover(), e.g. sound or device

Value

data frame of free appointments as returned by get_free_appointments() with an additional logical column is_new (TRUE if the appointment was not yet contained in state_file)

Details

The Pushover credentials are read from the environment variables PUSHOVER_USER (your user key) and PUSHOVER_APP (the API token of your Pushover application), see pushoverr::pushover().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Only print the free appointments
check_appointments()

# Send a Pushover notification about new free appointments of type
# "D. Saeuglings- u. Kleinkindsprechstunde" for patients with statutory
# health insurance
Sys.setenv(PUSHOVER_USER = "<user key>", PUSHOVER_APP = "<api token>")
check_appointments(
  event_type = "D",
  insurance = "gesetzlich",
  send_pushover_notification = TRUE,
  state_file = "notified-appointments.txt"
)
} # }
